question: कहानी में कौन खतरे (Danger) में है? 🐍
explanation: Yay! The poor साँप (Snake) is in danger in this story! 🐍
hint: It is a long animal with no legs.

question: साँप छुपने (To hide) के लिए कहाँ जाता है? 🕳️
explanation: Awesome! Snakes live and hide in a small बिल (Hole) in the ground! 🕳️
hint: It is a small, dark place under the ground.

question: जब साँप खतरे में होता है, तो वह कैसा महसूस (Feel) करता है? 😰
explanation: Super star! Animals feel डरा हुआ (Scared) when they are in danger! 😰
hint: Think about how you feel when you see something scary.

question: साँप कहाँ रेंगता (Crawls) है? 🌍
explanation: Great job! A snake crawls on the ज़मीन (Ground) using its belly! 🌍
hint: It is the place where we walk and play.

question: हमें डरे हुए जानवरों के साथ कैसा व्यवहार (Behave) करना चाहिए? ❤️
explanation: Excellent! We should always show प्यार (Love) and care to animals! ❤️
hint: It is a good and kind action.

question: बिल (Hole) के पास क्या उगी होती है? 🌱
explanation: Yay! Green घास (Grass) grows near the holes in the ground! 🌱
hint: It is green and grows in the garden.

question: सुरक्षित (Safe) होने पर साँप कैसा महसूस करता है? 😊
explanation: Awesome! When danger is gone, everyone feels खुश (Happy) and safe! 😊
hint: It is the feeling you get when you get a toy.

question: साँप किसके नीचे छुप (Hide) सकता है? 🪨
explanation: Super star! Snakes can hide under a big पत्थर (Stone) to stay safe! 🪨
hint: It is hard and found on the ground.

question: साँप कैसे चलता (Moves) है? 🐍
explanation: Great job! A snake has no legs, so it has to रेंगना (Crawl)! 🐍
hint: Moving on the belly close to the ground.

question: पेड़, जानवर और हम सब किसका हिस्सा (Part) हैं? 🌿
explanation: Excellent! Everything alive is a beautiful part of प्रकृति (Nature)! 🌿
hint: It includes trees, birds, and animals.

question: साँप को प्यास लगने पर क्या चाहिए? 💧
explanation: Yay! Like us, animals also drink पानी (Water) when they are thirsty! 💧
hint: It is clear and comes from rain.

question: अपने बिल (Hole) के अंदर साँप कैसा होता है? 🛡️
explanation: Awesome! Inside its home, the snake is perfectly सुरक्षित (Safe)! 🛡️
hint: Protected from all bad things.

question: जब खतरा (Danger) टल जाता है, साँप कहाँ आता है? 밖
explanation: Super star! When it is safe, the snake comes बाहर (Out) of the hole! 🚪
hint: The opposite of inside.

question: जानवरों की देखभाल (Care) करना क्या कहलाता है? 💖
explanation: Great job! Caring for animals shows our प्यार (Love) for them! 💖
hint: It is a kind feeling in our heart.

question: साँप का शरीर (Body) कैसा होता है? 📏
explanation: Excellent! A snake has a very लंबा (Long) and thin body! 📏
hint: Like a rope.

question: क्या साँप के पैर (Legs) होते हैं? 👣
explanation: Yay! Snakes have no legs, so the answer is नहीं (No)! ❌
hint: Think about how they crawl on their belly.

question: दिन के समय क्या चमकता (Shines) है? ☀️
explanation: Awesome! During the day, warm धूप (Sunlight) shines on the ground! ☀️
hint: It gives us light and heat during the day.

question: साँप और कहाँ छुप (Hide) सकता है? 🌿
explanation: Super star! A leafy झाड़ी (Bush) is a great place to hide! 🌿
hint: A plant with many small branches.

question: साँप की आँखें (Eyes) कैसी होती हैं? 👁️
explanation: Great job! A snake has small, गोल (Round) eyes to look around! 👁️
hint: Shaped like a tiny ball or circle.

question: क्या जानवरों को भी दर्द (Pain) होता है? 🤕
explanation: Excellent! Just like us, animals also feel pain. The answer is हाँ (Yes)! ✅
hint: If they get hurt, they feel it.

question: साँप किसके पास आराम (Rest) कर सकता है? 🌳
explanation: Yay! A snake loves to rest under a cool पेड़ (Tree)! 🌳
hint: It has green leaves and gives shade.

question: साँप किस पर खिसकता (Slides) है? 🐍
explanation: Awesome! A snake slides using its पेट (Belly) because it has no legs! 🐍
hint: The soft part under the animal's body.

question: साँप जैसी चीज़ें कहाँ रहती हैं? 🌲
explanation: Super star! Many animals, including snakes, live in the जंगल (Jungle)! 🌲
hint: A place with many wild trees and animals.

question: जानवर हमारे क्या होते हैं? 🤝
explanation: Great job! Animals are a part of nature and our दोस्त (Friend)! 🤝
hint: Someone you play with and care for.

question: बिल (Hole) साँप का क्या है? 🏠
explanation: Excellent! A hole in the ground is a warm घर (Home) for a snake! 🏠
hint: The place where you live and sleep safely.

question: पेड़ से क्या गिरता है जो साँप को डरा सकता है? 🍂
explanation: Yay! A falling पत्ता (Leaf) makes a sound that can scare small animals! 🍂
hint: It is green or dry and falls from trees.

question: बिल (Hole) किस चीज़ में बनता है? 🟤
explanation: Awesome! Snakes make or find holes in the soft मिट्टी (Mud)! 🟤
hint: It is brown and found in the garden.

question: साँप के आस-पास कौन फुदक (Hop) सकता है? 🐸
explanation: Super star! A small मेंढक (Frog) loves to hop around in the grass! 🐸
hint: It is green and goes 'ribbit'.

question: किस चीज़ से साँप डर (Fear) जाता है? 🔊
explanation: Great job! Loud शोर (Noise) can easily scare a shy snake! 🔊
hint: A loud sound.

question: साँप को क्या पसंद (Likes) है? 🤫
explanation: Excellent! Animals feel safe when there is शांति (Silence) around them! 🤫
hint: When there is no sound.

question: साँप किस समय धूप (Sunlight) में बैठता है? ☀️
explanation: Yay! The sun is out during the दिन (Day), keeping the snake warm! ☀️
hint: When you go to school.

question: साँप अपने बिल (Hole) में कब सोता है? 🌙
explanation: Awesome! Like us, snakes also rest and sleep at रात (Night)! 🌙
hint: When the moon and stars are out.

question: खतरा (Danger) होने पर हमें जानवरों से कहाँ रहना चाहिए? 🚶‍♂️
explanation: Super star! We should watch animals from दूर (Far) so they don't get scared! 🚶‍♂️
hint: Not close.

question: जब खतरा टल जाए, तो जानवर कहाँ आ जाते हैं? 🏞️
explanation: Great job! When safe, animals feel okay to come पास (Near) again! 🏞️
hint: Very close.

question: साँप एक प्रकार का क्या है? 🐾
explanation: Excellent! A snake is a creeping जानवर (Animal) found in nature! 🐾
hint: A living creature that moves on land.

question: घास (Grass) का रंग कैसा होता है? 🟢
explanation: Yay! The grass where snakes hide is a lovely हरा (Green) color! 🟢
hint: The color of tree leaves.

question: मिट्टी (Mud) का रंग कैसा होता है? 🟤
explanation: Awesome! The soil or mud is usually भूरा (Brown) in color! 🟤
hint: The color of chocolate.

question: साँप का बिल (Hole) कैसा होता है? 🤏
explanation: Super star! A snake fits nicely into a छोटा (Small) cozy hole! 🤏
hint: Not very big.

question: साँप की लंबाई (Length) कैसी हो सकती है? 📏
explanation: Great job! A snake can grow to be very बड़ा (Big) and long! 📏
hint: Very long and large.

question: बारिश होने पर साँप कहाँ जाता है? 🌧️
explanation: Excellent! When it rains, the snake goes अंदर (Inside) its dry hole! 🏠
hint: In the safe space of its home.

question: पेड़ के कहाँ पक्षी (Bird) बैठते हैं? 🌳
explanation: Yay! Birds sit high ऊपर (Up) on the branches of trees! 🌳
hint: High in the air.

question: साँप ज़मीन के कहाँ रहता है? 👇
explanation: Awesome! Snakes slither and live नीचे (Down) on the ground! 👇
hint: On the floor/ground.

question: साँप खतरे (Danger) से बचने के लिए कैसे भागता है? 💨
explanation: Super star! A snake moves very तेज़ (Fast) to hide from danger! 💨
hint: Very quickly.

question: कछुआ (Tortoise) कैसे चलता है? 🐢
explanation: Great job! Unlike the fast snake, a tortoise moves very धीमे (Slow)! 🐢
hint: Not quickly.

question: साँप कौन सी आवाज़ (Sound) निकालता है? 🐍
explanation: Excellent! A snake makes a 'hssss' sound called फुफकार (Hiss)! 🐍
hint: The sound a snake makes.

question: साँप कहाँ छुपकर खुद को बचाता है? 🕳️
explanation: Yay! It runs straight into its बिल (Hole) to stay safe! 🕳️
hint: The muddy house of a snake.

question: आसमान में कौन उड़ता (Flies) है? 🐦
explanation: Awesome! A चिड़िया (Bird) has wings to fly high in the sky! 🐦
hint: It has feathers and wings.

question: कौन सा जानवर घर की रखवाली करता है? 🐕
explanation: Super star! A pet कुत्ता (Dog) guards our home! 🐕
hint: It barks and wags its tail.

question: खतरे से बचने के लिए सबसे अच्छा तरीका क्या है? 🫣
explanation: Great job! Just like the snake, छुपना (Hide) keeps us safe from danger! 🫣
hint: Going out of sight.

question: हर जानवर को हमारी क्या चाहिए? 🥰
explanation: Excellent! Every beautiful animal deserves our प्यार (Love) and देखभाल (Care)! 🥰
hint: Helping and loving them.
